prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 3:4 aspect ratio, two women in a single row.

A photograph of TWO women standing side by side in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, the camera set back so all 2 fit comfortably within the frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, dim torchlight and flickering firelight raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Pakistani woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, gold-dust eyeshadow, a deep maroon lip, richly detailed bridal makeup, warm brown skin, a calm, distant gaze, high ponytail hair, real living eyes. Long round nails, matte finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size. Below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: painted in Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye — a deep indigo-blue ground with bold white resist-dyed motifs, wide white bands following every deep crease, dense spiral resist motifs filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Left woman's restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ankle fetter joined by its own short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, to one single huge black iron ring held low between her feet, so that the two ankle chains run from her two ankles and meet at that one ring. She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, hangs straight down the front of her body and is joined to that same ring between her feet, so that the neck chain and both ankle chains all meet at that one ring, the long chain hanging in a gentle slack curve.

Left woman's pose: standing full height, facing the camera, close beside the other woman, her feet a hand's width apart, her arms relaxed at her sides, the long chain hanging down the center of her body to the ring between her feet in view, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Left woman's footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones.

Right woman: a real adult Emirati woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, smoky bronze eyes, a soft nude lip, warm golden-tan skin, a soft, neutral expression, wavy hair, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic — a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs, wide ochre bands following every deep crease, dense spiral floral bands filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin, covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted, pattern fading at the neck.

Right woman's restraints: Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ankle fetter joined by its own short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, to one single huge black iron ring held low between her feet, so that the two ankle chains run from her two ankles and meet at that one ring. She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, hangs straight down the front of her body and is joined to that same ring between her feet, so that the neck chain and both ankle chains all meet at that one ring, the long chain hanging in a gentle slack curve.

Right woman's pose: standing full height, facing the camera, close beside the other woman, her feet a hand's width apart, her arms relaxed at her sides, the long chain hanging down the center of her body to the ring between her feet in view, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Right woman's footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones.

Composition: the whole row of women fills the width of the tall frame, each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly.

Skin (all): real photographic skin, visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, no illustration finish, no CG sheen.

Lighting: the light carving every fold and curve on all 2, catching each woman's own painted pattern distinctly. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 vertical portrait 8K, taller than it is wide.
